preservedResponsibilities: Paragraph/page/numbering style families, descriptors, canonical owner attachment, inheritance and typed properties.
omittedResponsibilities: Only the current canonical Writer core slice is represented. Full UNO service metadata/query interfaces, listeners, interactive undo/actions, Unicode cursor navigation, layout, unsupported character/table/conditional styles, ranges in unsupported sections, expanded bookmarks and wider properties remain unverified or unported. DomainMapper, OOXML package parser and export are outside this task; no whole-module parity claim.
